messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not drive or operate dangerous machinery until you know how it affects you"
set: ["do not drive or operate dangerous machinery until you know how it affects you", "do not drive or operate machinery until you know how it affects you", "do not drive or operate heavy machinery until you know how it affects you", "do not drive until you know how it affects you", "do not drive or do anything that needs alertness until you know how it affects you", "avoid driving or hazardous activity until you know how it affects you", "avoid driving and other tasks that need alertness until you know how it affects you", "do not drive or use machinery until effects are known", "avoid driving or hazardous activities until you know how tramadol will affect you", "caregiver must know where you keep it and how to use it", "be careful if you drive or do anything that requires you to be alert", "any healthcare provider should know you are taking it", "know all medicines you take", "prescriber will watch how you respond", "do not let it freeze", "do not stop unless doctor tells you to"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
